channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: “I Don’t Need International Law”: Trump Asserts Personal Morality Is His Only Check
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said that the only real constraint on his power on the world stage is his own morality, dismissing international law as a primary limitation on his actions.

item.title: Election Commission Draws Red Line on Voter List Monitoring
item.description: ECI cautions micro-observers of disciplinary action over SOP violations Kolkata, Jan 12 (IANS) The Election Commission of India has cautioned the micro-observers in West Bengal of strong disciplinary action in case of any deliberate deviation from the ECI-prescribed standard operating procedure (SOP) for them.

item.title: Bangladesh polls: Leaders refuse to return to NCP after alliance with Jamaat
item.description: Bangladesh's National Citizen Party (NCP) continues to struggle amid internal differences following its alliance with radical Islamist party Jamaat-e-Islami, as leaders who left the party remain firm on their decision, rejecting overtures from the leadership to bring them back.

item.title: Virat Kohli Scripts History with 28,000 Runs as India Beat New Zealand in 1st ODI
item.description: India batter Shreyas Iyer reserved special praise for Virat Kohli after the latter achieved two major milestones with his brilliant 93-run knock in the first ODI against New Zealand on Sunday.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower amid rising geopolitical tensions
item.description: The US administration's strange comments are complicating the US-India trade deal, they added. The Venezuelan crisis, Iran crisis, and US President Donal Trump's threats on Greenland are also worrying the stock markets, raising the India VIX, indicating high volatility.

item.title: Pongal rush: 11 lakhs leave Chennai; public transportation, road traffic under strain
item.description: An estimated 11 lakh people left Chennai for various parts of Tamil Nadu and neighbouring states over the weekend ahead of the Pongal festival, triggering a massive surge in demand for public transport and heavy congestion on major highways.

item.title: “You Never Get Bored Watching Him”: Chitrangda on Salman Khan
item.description: Actress Chitrangda Singh, who will next be seen in “Battle Of Galwan”, has heaped praise on superstar Salman Khan, calling him an instinctive performer whose vast experience reflects effortlessly in his work.

item.title: On Swami Vivekananda Jayanti, Mamata Banerjee Calls for Unity, Peace and Harmony
item.description: On the occasion of the 163rd birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda on Monday, West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has given a call to the people to move ahead on the path of “unity, peace and harmony”.

item.title: India–Germany Ties Get Fresh Push as PM Modi Meets Chancellor Merz in Gandhinagar
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz held delegation-level talks at the Mahatma Mandir Convention Centre in Gandhinagar on Monday, focusing on enhancing cooperation across various sectors.

item.title: Kolkata Police to seek details of ED officers involved in I-PAC raids
item.description: Kolkata Police have decided to formally approach the Enforcement Directorate (ED) to obtain the names and details of officers who conducted raids last week at the I-PAC office in Salt Lake and the residence of its director, Pratik Jain, on Loudon Street.
